Done. All three functions are implemented and exported:

1. **clamp(n, min, max)** — limits n to [min, max]
2. **formatBytes(n)** — formats byte counts with one decimal place (B, KB, MB, GB)
3. **slugify(title)** — converts titles to lowercase, dash-separated slugs with only alphanumerics and dashes
